request.user:
Subject: Botany
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Who provided the evidence for the production of glucose when plant grows?
(A) Julius von Sachs
(B) Stephen Hales
(C) Lavoisier
(D) Von Helmont

result.working: In 1854 Julius von Sachs showed that plants produce glucose when they grow. The glucose is usually stored as starch. He also showed that the green substance, chlorophyll, sits in special bodies (later called chloroplasts) inside the cells. This is the standard NCERT account of the history of photosynthesis. The other options made different contributions: Stephen Hales worked on plant physiology and transpiration, Lavoisier on combustion and oxygen, and Van Helmont did the willow tree experiment.
result.note: The option spells the name 'Von Helmont'; the usual spelling is Van Helmont.
